newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finmin appoints Bangchak advisors.
newsitem.headline: Thai finmin appoints Bangchak advisors.

text.p: The Thai finance ministry will name on Thursday Thai Investment and Securities Plc (TISCO), Jardine Fleming Thanakom Securities Co, and Phatra Thanakit Plc as its financial advisors on its plan to sell shares in The Bangchak Petroleum Plc.
A TISCO official said the ministry will conclude a five- month advisory agreement with the brokerage firms which would help it float 31 percent of Bangchak's 522 million shares.
He said Bangchak has not decided on the share price to be offered, the timing of the float, or who would underwrite it.
Montree Sornpaisarn, executive vice-president of Jardine Fleming said: "There is a common understanding that it is quite likely for the advisors to lead a future issue though there is no guarantee."

The Thai government last year instructed state-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand to sell its 24.2 percent stake in Bangchak, and asked the finance ministry to trim its holding to 41.2 percent from 47.8.
It said Krung Thai Bank Plc's 7.9 percent interest in Bangchak would be maintained.
